text:
Nora: Quick sync - want to frame MVP as a hypothesis test rather than a feature checklist. My proposal: cut Tenant Reporting and Role Admin to v1, keep SSO, onboarding, prompt-store, embeddings export, and a single "search-recall" UI in MVP. We ship with two guardrails: a P95 latency cap and a hard monthly cost burn default. Thoughts?

Caleb: +1 to hypothesis framing. Can we define measurable success criteria? e.g., 3 pilot tenants complete onboarding and perform X searches/day; search TTFB < 300ms for 80% of queries.

Sanjay: Infra constraints: shipping search-recall with no embcache means tail latency spikes for >512 tokens. Options:
- implement lightweight prefix cache (tenant prompts only) ~5d work
- accept degraded tail and monitor with probes
- roll flag-controlled cache after GA
Estimate: prefix cache = 2 eng days + 1 SRE day.

Priya: For pilots we need clear acceptance gates. Suggest a short checklist in the product doc:
- 3 pilot tenants onboarded end-to-end
- SSO (Okta) success rate >= 95%
- Search recall P95 <= 400ms (soft), <= 300ms (target)
- Daily embeddings export completes within 24h
Include a go/no-go owner per gate.

Marta: Customer risk note: removing Tenant Reporting reduces early ROI signal. We should compensate by surfacing simple adoption metrics in the admin console (counts only) so pilot tenants can see usage. That is lower-effort than full reporting and still shows value.

Nora: Good call. Add a "counts-only" dashboard tile (total searches, exports, active users) for MVP. Low dev lift?

Caleb: Counts-only tile: yes, can be event-sourced and cheap. I can take it if SRE agrees on metrics retention window.

Sanjay: Metrics retention: store 7d raw events for pilots, roll to 30d post-GA. Will need ~1d infra work.

Priya: Launch guardrails: add two runtime flags -> `mvp.latency-guard=true` (auto-throttle long requests) and `mvp.cost-cap=750` (soft stop, ops alert). These let ops cut load without full rollback.

flag-bot: Reminder: feature flags should be documented and have QA steps. See /flags playbook.

Marta: Let's also define rollback window: 48h post-GA where we won't merge tenant-admin or reporting features. Gives us breathing room to stabilize.

Nora: Timeline suggestion: scope lock Fri EOD; dev freeze Tue 09:00; pilot start 2026-02-19; GA target 2026-03-08. If pilot fails any gate we open a pause and triage within 24h.

Caleb: Action items: Nora -> update hypothesis doc + owners; Caleb -> counts tile + retention plan; Sanjay -> prefix cache estimate and probes; Priya -> gate owners and flags; Marta -> coordinate pilot tenants. I'll open PRs with labels `mvp-hypothesis` and `pilot-ready`.

Nora: Thanks. If no objections by EOD Fri I'll mark the cutboard and announce to stakeholders. :rocket:
